capabilities.description: Place a library part on the 10-unit grid; unused optional ID; bounds in snapshot.limits

id.description: Omitted/empty allocates an unused designator; explicit ID cannot have been used earlier in this session, including after delete.

value.description: Omitted/empty uses factory value; net-label uses new ID as name; non-value symbols require omitted/empty value. Supplied numeric values use the per-kind domains; new waveforms use factory offset/low level.

preconditions: A drawing slot is free; explicit ID unused in this session
Finite position within ±10000 units; coordinates snap to nearest 10-unit grid and snapped position must be unoccupied
effects: Commits through ordinary electrical edit/restart/paused-stale and undo rules; invalid input preserves previous graph/physics/history
Selects placed part and returns drawing tool to select; net helpers count toward drawing-object bound, not simulated-part capacity

x-network-numerics.cold_start_fallback: After a failed ordinary nonlinear cold start, retry once with only voltages fixed by ideal paths to ground initialized; startup capacitors participate only at dt=0. No substitute device equations or accepted result. Warm guesses retain their path.
x-network-numerics.iteration_budget: 100 iterations per Newton attempt; one additional grounded-constraint cold-start retry; existing per-NPN seed retries remain. Cancellation and integration attempt/time budgets still apply.
x-network-numerics.linear_correction: Full affine MNA correction; even zero excitation checks matrix rank before acceptance
x-network-numerics.nonlinear_correction: Damped Newton; LED, silicon diode, NPN, NMOS, PMOS and unknown future devices retain damping
x-network-numerics.rank_check: Every Newton attempt solves its matrix before accepting even a zero-residual initial guess; floating insulated gates are not assigned an arbitrary zero
x-network-numerics.time_integration: Existing backward-Euler/adaptive error and per-output attempt/time budgets; no simplified model substitution

x-source-reference-rules.dc-source: Value is positive minus negative; either terminal may be offset from ground in a referenced network
x-source-reference-rules.network: A common ground reference and independent source/capacitor constraints remain required; accepted node voltages stay within ±30 V and existing solve/work limits

mutation_preconditions.combination: A revision guard is required; all supplied revision/document guards must match
mutation_preconditions.expected_command_revision: Guards admitted commands, including other actors; live solver publication does not invalidate it
mutation_preconditions.expected_document_generation: Optional mutation context guard; prevents applying an old rendered action to a replacement document, including background publication
mutation_preconditions.expected_revision: Guards all state publication, including live samples

discovery.retry_retention: Latest 256 successful mutation keys per session; reconnect to the same process preserves them. Expired keys have no deduplication guarantee.
